import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter data for top 10 breeds by number of registrations
top_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index
filtered_data = data[data['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Create a count plot of dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.countplot(data=filtered_data, y='Rasse1Text', order=top_breeds, palette='viridis')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds Registered in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=14)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter data for top 10 breeds by number of registrations
top_breeds = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index
filtered_data = data[data['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Create a count plot of dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.countplot(data=filtered_data, y='Rasse1Text', order=top_breeds, palette='viridis')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds Registered in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=14)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
